data.description: 毕业后的艾莲独自在私人实验室中，坐在讲台边，一手扶稳烧杯架，另一手留在撩起的裙摆下。鲨鱼尾巴蜷在座位旁，金红夕光斜穿窗框，照着泛红的脸颊。
data.lighting: 浓稠金红夕阳斜射穿透窗框，打在泛红脸颊与雪白肌肤上的暖光
data.location: 毕业后私人实验室的讲台
data.promptProse: Seated on the private post-graduation laboratory podium, Ellen steadies a beaker rack with one hand while touching herself with the other, her tail curled beside the seat. Low gold-red sunlight enters diagonally through the window frames.
data.title: 艾莲·乔 · 私人实验室的暮色独处
data.animaCaption: One hand steadies the beaker rack; her tail curls beside the podium seat.
